options.text: a - i, b - iii, c - ii, d - iv
a - i, b - iii, c - iv, d - ii
a - iv, b - iii, c - ii, d - i
a - iii, b - iv, c - ii, d - i

solution:
The correct answer is __**a - i, b - iii, c - ii, d - iv**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 1** correctly matches the compounds in Column-A with their corresponding types in Column-B.
 
• Alkanes are saturated hydrocarbons and Ethane (i) is an example.
 
• Alkenes are unsaturated hydrocarbons with at least one double bond, and Propene (iii) fits this category.
 
• Alkynes are unsaturated hydrocarbons with at least one triple bond, and Butyne (ii) is an example.
 
• Aldehydes are organic compounds containing a formyl group, and Methanal (iv) is an example.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ethane (C₂H₆) is a simple alkane with single bonds.
 
• Propene (C₃H₆) contains a double bond, classifying it as an alkene.
 
• Butyne (C₄H₆) contains a triple bond, making it an alkyne.
 
• Methanal (CH₂O), also known as formaldehyde, is the simplest aldehyde.
